content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To drink creatine, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Pour the creatine powder into the glass (10 seconds)
Step 2. Rinse the used spoon (30 seconds)
Step 3. Research different creatine brands online (2 hours)
Step 4. Open the creatine tub lid (5 seconds)
Step 5. Check the expiration date on the label (10 seconds)
Step 6. Select a reputable supplement brand (30 minutes)
Step 7. Take a small sip of water to clear your throat (5 seconds)
Step 8. Put the creatine tub back in the cupboard (15 seconds)
Step 9. Stir the mixture vigorously (20 seconds)
Step 10. Walk to the kitchen (1 minute)
Step 11. Locate a clean spoon in the drawer (10 seconds)
Step 12. Enter the kitchen area (5 seconds)
Step 13. Observe the powder dissolving in the liquid (45 seconds)
Step 14. Take a clean glass out of the cabinet (10 seconds)
Step 15. Dry the spoon with a towel (15 seconds)
Step 16. Inspect the glass for any spots (5 seconds)
Step 17. Place the glass on the countertop (5 seconds)
Step 18. Drink the entire contents of the glass (30 seconds)
Step 19. Turn on the kitchen overhead light (2 seconds)
Step 20. Clear a space on the counter (20 seconds)
Step 21. Bring the glass to your lips (3 seconds)
Step 22. Wipe any spilled powder off the counter (40 seconds)
Step 23. Remove the plastic safety seal from the tub (15 seconds)
Step 24. Dig through the powder to find the plastic scoop (30 seconds)
Step 25. Measure out exactly five grams of creatine (20 seconds)
Step 26. Buy a new tub of creatine at the store (45 minutes)
Step 27. Bring the creatine tub to the kitchen (1 minute)
Step 28. Set the faucet to the desired temperature (10 seconds)
Step 29. Tap the side of the tub to settle the powder (5 seconds)
Step 30. Fill the glass with 8 ounces of water (15 seconds)
Step 31. Add a splash of fruit juice for flavor (10 seconds)
Step 32. Rinse the glass with a little water first (10 seconds)
Step 33. Ensure the glass is completely dry inside (20 seconds)
Step 34. Read the dosage instructions on the back (1 minute)
Step 35. Prepare a small snack to eat afterward (5 minutes)
Step 36. Check your phone for a workout reminder (1 minute)
Step 37. Recycle the paper seal from the tub (20 seconds)
Step 38. Decide which liquid to mix the powder with (30 seconds)
Step 39. Shake the tub to loosen the contents (10 seconds)
Step 40. Double check the water level in the glass (5 seconds)
Step 41. Watch the vortex form while stirring (10 seconds)
Step 42. Position the glass under the tap (5 seconds)
Step 43. Take a deep breath before drinking (3 seconds)
Step 44. Close the creatine tub tightly (10 seconds)
Step 45. Swallow the mixture (5 seconds)
Step 46. Set the empty glass in the sink (5 seconds)
Step 47. Stand comfortably by the sink (5 seconds)
Step 48. Wash your hands (40 seconds)
Step 49. Put the juice bottle back in the fridge (30 seconds)
Step 50. Inspect the glass for cracks (5 seconds)
Step 51. Mentally prepare for the chalky taste (10 seconds)
Step 52. Tap the spoon on the rim to knock off excess (5 seconds)
Step 53. Grab the water pitcher (10 seconds)
Step 54. Wipe the bottom of the glass (10 seconds)
Step 55. Add an ice cube to the glass (5 seconds)
Step 56. Pour water into the glass (10 seconds)
Step 57. Place the spoon in the sink (5 seconds)
Step 58. Clean up any water droplets on the floor (1 minute)
Step 59. Set the stirring spoon aside (5 seconds)
Step 60. Check the scoop size against the label (15 seconds)
Step 61. Tilt your head back (2 seconds)
Step 62. Tap the spoon against the drawer (5 seconds)
Step 63. Look at the clock to time the intake (10 seconds)
Step 64. Close the refrigerator door (3 seconds)
Step 65. Pick up the glass (3 seconds)
Step 66. Realize you are thirsty (2 seconds)
Step 67. Get a napkin (15 seconds)
Step 68. Put away the dish towel (20 seconds)
Step 69. Wake up and start your morning routine (15 minutes)
Step 70. Adjust your grip on the glass (2 seconds)
